runners_data.name: Papillondelumiere
runners_data.note: Hold-up style veteran with 48 days off and amateur rider faces tough task against this quality

runners_data.name: Edelak
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Dan Skelton's 31% strike-rate and Harry Skelton booking suggests confidence after recent second

runners_data.name: Crackalackin
runners_data.note: Prominent type who must prove stamina at this trip but brings solid recent form from shorter distances

runners_data.name: Garde My Guinness
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner returning after 256 days but has excellent course record and proven stamina

runners_data.name: Backer Bilk
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with good recent Huntingdon second giving course confidence and current form edge

runners_data.name: Versatile
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying top weight after 30 days off with claiming rider reducing chances significantly

runners_data.name: Pic N Mix
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with weak form figures and lowest official rating makes winning unlikely despite conditions

runners_data.name: Trackman
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with highest rating but 131 days absence and unknown current form creates major doubts

races.paceDynamic: Edelak looks the only committed pace-setter in this small field, with Crackalackin, Garde My Guinness and Pic N Mix likely to sit just behind in the early stages. The lack of genuine speed horses means Edelak can dictate terms without pressure, creating a steady rhythm that builds gradually. With three hold-up horses (Papillondelumiere, Backer Bilk, Versatile, Trackman) having to rely on the pace collapsing, this tactical setup clearly favours the prominent racers who can track the leader and have first strike when the race develops. This shape definitively suits prominent runners over hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Edelak Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Edelak maintains his recent form improvement and faces no early pressure
scenarios.body: Harry Skelton can dictate ideal fractions from the front, with the Dan Skelton runner proving too strong when the prominent horses challenge turning in. The hold-up brigade have too much ground to make up in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Crackalackin or Garde My Guinness press Edelak from the early stages
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for the more experienced Garde My Guinness to use his consistent record at this trip. Crackalackin's recent form gives him every chance if staying the trip strongly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Backer Bilk's recent second at Huntingdon gives him course knowledge and his hold-up style could prosper if getting a true test of stamina. The longer the race stays together, the more dangerous the patient types become.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Edelak goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Trackman's highest official rating suggests class could tell in a tactical finish where jumping becomes crucial. Any of the more experienced hold-up horses could capitalise if the race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: Edelak's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when challenged could derail his front-running tactics completely
Garde My Guinness fitness after 256-day absence - returning horses often need the run despite previous course success
Crackalackin staying power at 2 miles - has never won beyond 12 furlongs and stamina remains unproven
Early pace development - if Pic N Mix or Crackalackin press Edelak early it transforms the tactical picture
Backer Bilk's jumping rhythm - hold-up horses need clean rounds to have any chance in this pace scenario

races.name: Tattersalls Online Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to small field dynamics, though 10-year-old faces younger legs in the finish

runners_data.name: Jack Doyen
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage but brings the best recent form and class edge to overcome it

runners_data.name: Kapamazov
runners_data.note: Prominent style should get ideal position tracking leader, though long absence and poor recent strike-rate concern

runners_data.name: Pleasure Garden
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with useful weight allowance but trainer's poor 14-day record and 44 days since last run worry

runners_data.name: Chateau Du Lys
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces pace disadvantage but brings youth advantage and tongue-tie fitted suggests connections expect improvement

races.paceDynamic: Cloudy Wednesday will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace-pressers, allowing the 10-year-old to bowl along at a comfortable rhythm over this stamina-testing trip. Kapamazov and Pleasure Garden will track prominently but neither has the early pace to challenge Cloudy Wednesday's lead, while Jack Doyen and Chateau Du Lys will drop in behind from their hold-up positions. The uncontested leader scenario combined with good ground that will allow sustained galloping strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics, making life difficult for the hold-up horses who will face a stiff task reeling back a horse that gets first run on them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday maintains a steady gallop without serious pace pressure through the early stages
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when ready, with the hold-up horses facing too much ground to make up. This plays perfectly to Cloudy Wednesday's natural front-running style on ground that will allow sustained galloping.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kapamazov or Pleasure Garden can sit close enough to pounce when Cloudy Wednesday comes under pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before striking in the final half-mile when stamina tells. Their superior ratings suggest they can outstay the leader if positioned right.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady enough for Jack Doyen to close from off the pace
scenarios.body: The class horse can use his superior turn of foot despite the tactical disadvantage, particularly if others have gone too hard too early. His recent winning form suggests he's capable of defying unfavorable pace dynamics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chateau Du Lys Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a genuine staying test where stamina trumps class and tactics
scenarios.body: The youngest horse in the field gets the run of the race from his hold-up position and outstays his elders in a war of attrition. His recent second suggests he's in good heart despite modest ratings.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Kapamazov shows early pace to pressure Cloudy Wednesday - could collapse the race for both
Monitor Jack Doyen's early position - if too far back on this pace setup his class may not be enough
Check Pleasure Garden's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes will end hopes given ground to make up
Observe Chateau Du Lys settling - if fighting for his head early the hold-up plan becomes impossible
Watch Cloudy Wednesday's jumping fluency - any errors will invite pressure he's not used to handling

races.name: Tattersalls Ireland May Hit & P2P Sale Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Ride Like A Girl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 175 days but showed winning form before layoff and should appreciate the likely lack of early pace pressure

runners_data.name: Callin Baton Rouge
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with highest RPR of 107 but needs luck in running with so many similar tactical types in the field

runners_data.name: Alibey
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who can sit second to Ride Like A Girl and benefits from talented jockey despite 7lb claim

runners_data.name: Miracles Do Happen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off a recent win but Tom Lacey's poor 14-day strike rate of 0/8 is concerning

runners_data.name: Eastern Shores
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to aim at but has been consistent in similar company recently

runners_data.name: Klervia
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 13lb weight advantage but inexperienced 5lb claimer Tom Broughton is a significant negative

runners_data.name: Adaay Dancing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest recent RPR of 103 but the 43-day layoff and inconsistent recent form are concerns

runners_data.name: Driving Miss d'Azy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 193 days with poor recent form and needs everything to fall right

races.paceDynamic: Ride Like A Girl will likely lead from the outset with Alibey and Klervia providing prominent company, creating a modest early gallop that shouldn't be overly taxing. The majority of the field - Callin Baton Rouge, Miracles Do Happen, Eastern Shores, Adaay Dancing, and Driving Miss d'Azy - are confirmed hold-up performers who will sit off the pace. With limited early pace pressure and five hold-up horses needing to make their move simultaneously, this creates a tactical bottleneck approaching the final hurdle. The race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent runners who can avoid traffic and dictate terms from the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ride Like A Girl and Alibey can maintain a steady tempo without being harassed by the field
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows them to conserve energy for a strong finish while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. Prominent positioning becomes decisive when five horses try to make their move at once.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up timing perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early or one of the hold-up horses gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: Callin Baton Rouge or Miracles Do Happen could exploit their superior recent form ratings when getting first run on the leaders. Their class advantage shows when they avoid the tactical scramble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical scramble chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace creates a bunched field turning for home with multiple horses making their move
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where jockey positioning matters more than running style preferences. Inexperienced riders like Tom Broughton on Klervia could struggle in the heat of battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ride Like A Girl goes too slow and the field comes to her with a furlong to run
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where the highest-rated horses with tactical speed can quicken best. Superior class ratings of Callin Baton Rouge and Adaay Dancing become decisive in a slowly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Ride Like A Girl could get an easy lead if Alibey and Klervia don't press early enough, making her very difficult to peg back
Traffic problems likely in the straight as five hold-up horses - Callin Baton Rouge, Miracles Do Happen, Eastern Shores, Adaay Dancing, and Driving Miss d'Azy - all need room at once
Tom Broughton's inexperience on Klervia could be costly in a tactically-run race where positioning is crucial
Callin Baton Rouge has the class to win but absolutely must get luck in running from his hold-up style with so much similar company
Going conditions firming up throughout the card could catch out any horse not fully tuned up after a break

runners_data.note: Leading style with first-time blinkers applied and 26 days since last run may struggle to sustain gallop over extended trip.

runners_data.name: Ballintubber Boy
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner returning from 210-day layoff but has strong record fresh and excellent course form.

runners_data.name: Kitty Foyle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5-pound claiming jockey but has winning form at this level and suits likely pace scenario.

runners_data.name: Sunray Shadow
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer for in-form Dan Skelton stable but limited experience on good going may count against.

runners_data.name: Tiger Orchid
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with consistent recent form who will appreciate any strong early pace from the front runners.

runners_data.name: Alien Storm
runners_data.note: Class hold-up performer whose recent third suggests return to form and will benefit from expected honest gallop.

runners_data.name: Gasmani
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with useful recent form who sits perfectly positioned just behind the likely early leaders.

runners_data.name: Billy Boi Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent style with 3-pound claiming rider who may lack pace to live with the front runners early doors.

races.paceDynamic: Thank You Ma'am and Ballintubber Boy are both confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, ensuring a genuine gallop from the start. With 8 runners over 3m1f, the pace will be honest but not suicidal, as both leaders have the stamina to sustain their efforts. The majority of the field (Kitty Foyle, Sunray Shadow, Tiger Orchid, Alien Storm) are hold-up horses who will track the leaders before making their moves in the straight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can time their challenge late, as the early pace will set up perfectly for closers to pick off tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Thank You Ma'am and Ballintubber Boy is strong enough to compromise them both late on.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will perfectly set up the multiple hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. Kitty Foyle and Alien Storm are best positioned to capitalize with their strong closing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If one of the two leaders manages to steal a march and build an unassailable lead.
scenarios.body: Thank You Ma'am or Ballintubber Boy will get first run on the field and prove too strong for the closers to reel in. The winner will have judged the pace perfectly to have enough left for the climb to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses with both leaders going too slow or one falling away early.
scenarios.body: Billy Boi Blue and Gasmani will be perfectly placed just behind the leaders to take advantage of any hesitation. Their prominent position gives them tactical advantage over the hold-up horses who need a strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Thank You Ma'am and Ballintubber Boy fail to go forward aggressively from the start.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with no genuine pace, turning into a sprint finish where class tells. The highest-rated horses will benefit most from a slow-run race that becomes all about acceleration.

watchPoints.text: Thank You Ma'am and Ballintubber Boy both going forward too aggressively early could set up perfect race for closers
Sunray Shadow has limited good going experience which could be crucial on this faster surface
Kitty Foyle's 5-pound claimer Robbie David may struggle with tactical decisions in competitive handicap
Ballintubber Boy returning from 210-day break needs to prove fitness over this extended trip
Tiger Orchid's 11-year-old legs need watching for signs of fatigue in the closing stages

runners_data.name: Lightning Flash

runners_data.name: Breezethroughlife
runners_data.note: Another prominent type who handles the going well but may lack the class edge of his main rivals in this small field.

runners_data.name: Ice Jet
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly placed to benefit from the likely moderate pace with Harry Skelton able to time his challenge perfectly.

runners_data.name: American Trio
runners_data.note: Natural leader who will control the tempo but his established pattern of fading late is a major concern despite the class advantage.

races.paceDynamic: American Trio will lead from the start and set a comfortable, sustainable pace with no other natural front-runners to pressure him early. Lightning Flash and Breezethroughlife will track prominently behind, while Ice Jet will be held up at the back by Harry Skelton. The lone leader scenario creates a moderate tempo that should quicken turning for home, but American Trio's tendency to fade late opens the door for closers. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the lack of early pace pressure means stamina will tell in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If American Trio sets his usual moderate pace and fades as expected
scenarios.body: Ice Jet gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick from the back, taking advantage of the sustainable early gallop. Harry Skelton's patient tactics and the horse's recent winning form make him ideally suited to this unfolding.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and Lightning Flash or Breezethroughlife can outstay American Trio
scenarios.body: The Twiston-Davies team's strong recent record combines with Lightning Flash's consistent prominent style to capitalize on the moderate tempo. The race becomes a battle of stamina between the prominent runners in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If American Trio finds more stamina than usual and the pace stays slow throughout
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace preserves enough energy for American Trio to resist late challengers, despite his usual fading tendency. His class advantage at this trip distance proves decisive when not over-extended early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If American Trio stops badly and the prominent horses also weaken
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace leaves all runners with too much to do late, creating a messy finish where any horse finding extra can win. Ice Jet's superior finishing speed becomes even more valuable in a slowly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: American Trio's jumping early on - any mistakes will compromise his ability to maintain a smooth lead and could expose him to more pressure
Ice Jet's position turning for home - if Skelton gets too far back in this small field he may struggle to make up the ground
Lightning Flash's response to pressure - his recent fourth at this track suggests he may struggle when the pace quickens
The pace through the middle section - if it stays too steady the finish could become a pure stamina test
Breezethroughlife's jumping under pressure - any errors late on could cost him in what may be a tight finish

runners_data.name: Sambezi

runners_data.name: On Lovers Walk

races.paceDynamic: Whats The Solution will lead from the front with no other confirmed early pace in this small field. The four prominent runners (O'Hallorans Castle, Sambezi, On Lovers Walk) will track behind but none are aggressive enough to pressure the leader early. This creates a sustainable gallop that will likely quicken late when the hold-up horses Kandor, J'envoievalserenki and Surprise Attack try to close. The measured early pace and inevitable late acceleration strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains moderate and Whats The Solution sets steady fractions
scenarios.body: The hold-up trio get perfect positioning to unleash late runs while the prominent runners have no tactical advantage. Kandor and Surprise Attack's class tells when they can time their challenges optimally.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Whats The Solution gets uncontested fractions and the field fails to organize a strong finish
scenarios.body: The leader builds an insurmountable advantage as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground. Recent good form and lack of early pressure allows the front runner to kick clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If On Lovers Walk or Sambezi travel strongly and kick before the hold-up horses wind up
scenarios.body: The best-positioned tracker gets first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic that hampers the closers. On Lovers Walk's recent winning form and ideal position proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: No horse gets into an ideal rhythm and it becomes about who handles the sudden acceleration best. The race turns into a lottery where any runner in the right position can strike.

watchPoints.text: Whats The Solution faces the pressure of making all the running - if challenged early, stamina reserves may drain quickly
Both Kandor and Surprise Attack return from lengthy absences over 350 days which raises major fitness concerns despite their class advantage
O'Hallorans Castle and J'envoievalserenki both show concerning finishing patterns in their recent form that could repeat here
The good to firm going conditions are faster than ideal for several runners who prefer softer surfaces
Three amateur jockeys aboard key chances adds an additional layer of tactical uncertainty in a race requiring precise timing
